gloss: female equivalent of studentas (“(higher education) student”)
old town (older historical part of a city)
yard, courtyard, forecourt (open area outside or in between buildings)
balcony (a platform with railings protruding from the outside of the wall of a house)
garage (building or room for the storage or maintenance of vehicles)
bar (place where alcoholic beverages are sold)

cold borscht (a traditional soup made of beetroot)
nut (fruit with a hard shell and edible kernel) (especially) hazelnut
kvass (a fermented cereal-based low alcoholic beverage, often flavored with fruit, honey and herbs.)
